description: Create a new review annotation on a markdown file. Finds the anchor text in the document and attaches a review memo. Auto-creates a quality gate and updates cursor.

anchorText.description: The exact text in the document to annotate (must exist in the file)

file.description: Path to the annotated markdown file

occurrence.description: Which occurrence of anchorText to annotate (1-indexed, default 1). Use when the same text appears multiple times.

text.description: The review feedback or note to attach

type.description: fix = needs change, question = needs clarification, highlight = mark for reference

name: create_annotation
